description: Python pipeline and read-only MCP server for 25+ years of HKEX (Hong Kong Stock Exchange) regulatory filings: full-text extraction into PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, DuckDB, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Neo4j or SurrealDB, plus a hosted live MCP gateway for AI agents.
rules: Install with `pip install hkex-filing-scraper` (add the `[mcp]` extra for the MCP server); the PyPI package name is `hkex-filing-scraper`.
Select the destination database with the `DATABASE_TARGET` environment variable; see docs/configuration.md for every variable.
Use the hosted live MCP gateway when no local database is needed; use the local stdio server `hkex-scraper-mcp` to query a corpus you have already scraped.
All MCP tools are read-only and idempotent; there are no write or delete tools.
Date flags on the CLI are `--from-date` and `--to-date` in DD/MM/YYYY format.
